scripts.export: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../google-drive-blog.zip index.js
scripts.latest: node -e "require('./index').handler({path: '/api/recipes', headers: { origin: 'https://spencer.carvers.info' }, requestContext: {}, pathParameters: { post: 'latest' } }).then(console.log);"
scripts.get: node -e "require('./index').handler({path: '/api/blog', headers: { origin: 'https://spencer.carvers.info' }, requestContext: {}, pathParameters: { post: 'markdown-sample' } }).then(console.log);"
scripts.get:injection: node -e "require('./index').handler({path: '/api/blog', headers: { origin: 'https://spencer.carvers.info' }, requestContext: {}, pathParameters: { post: \"x' or name contains '\" } }).then(console.log);"
